sampling: Body blocks (prose paragraphs, tables, display equations; headings and images excluded) numbered 1-29 from L16; took blocks 1,4,7,...,28, then wrapped to 2,5,...,23. Claims drawn from L16, L26, L34, L42, L64, L72, L80-85, L93, L99, L66, L87, L36.

A: Headings are topic names, not claims: L18 '## 연구 배경', L28 '## 제안 방법', L46 '## 구현 방식', L68 '## 실험 결과' (fixed 5-section summary shape otherwise fine; markup, math and front matter render correctly).
B: L42 three consecutive '그래서' sentences: '그래서 α가 학습률과 같은 역할을 합니다. 그래서 저자들은 ...' -> 'α는 학습률과 같은 구실을 하므로, 저자들은 처음 시도한 r 값을 α로 정하고 따로 튜닝하지 않았습니다.'
Terminology mixing: L93 'r=8과 그보다 큰 rank', '더 큰 rank로' vs '랭크' everywhere else; L40 '단일 forward' vs L22 '단일 순전파'.
English default verbs: L42 '학습률과 같은 역할을 합니다', L97 '모델이 원래 가진 표현' -> '학습률과 같은 효과를 냅니다', '모델에 이미 있는 표현'.
Noun frame L70 '... 이 정도 성능이 나온다는 뜻입니다'.
C: Wrong cross-reference L78: '저자들은 연구 배경에서 소개한 MNLI 저데이터 과제를 썼습니다' - the 연구 배경 section (L18-26) never mentions the MNLI low-data task.
Dangling back-reference L70: '앞서 든 예처럼 GPT-3를 WikiSQL에 맞춘다면' - no earlier WikiSQL example exists.
L40 re-explains adapters and repeats the GPT-2 medium / Quadro RTX8000 / '30% 넘게' latency measurement already given at L22 and L26, so the method section reads stitched.
D: L44 '규모를 가늠하기 위해 가상의 계산을 해 보겠습니다' stays symbolic (d+k, (d+k)/(dk)) and never plugs in d=k=12,288, so the scale is not actually shown.
Good: α/r scaling (L42) and the subspace-similarity formula (L91-93) get symbol definitions at the point of use.
E: No table for the headline GPT-3 175B comparison (FT 73.8/89.5/52.0-28.0-44.5 vs LoRA 73.4-74.0/91.6-91.7/53.4-53.8...), while L70 claims '같거나 더 높은 성능' without a single number.
Figures (L24, L38, L74) are referred to descriptively and placed where discussed; tables L54-62 and L80-85 copy cells verbatim.
F: L26 'LoRA는 모듈을 병렬로 붙이는 구조라서 이런 지연이 생기지 않습니다' - the paper's reason is merging W=W0+BA at deployment ('we can explicitly compute and store W=W0+BA ... this guarantees that we do not introduce any additional latency'); an unmerged parallel branch still adds compute. L48 later gives the right reason.
L70 'W_q와 W_v에 붙인 작은 A·B만 학습해도 이 정도 성능이 나온다' - the Table 4 LoRA rows (4.7M, 37.7M) are not stated as W_q,W_v; Table 15 shows 4.7M/73.4/91.7 is r_v=2 (W_v only). Outside the claim sample.

L97 'W_q·W_v에 붙인 랭크 1~4의 작은 행렬도 ... SQL 생성에 필요한 방향을 증폭할 뿐입니다' - the amplification analysis (Section 7.3, H.3) is on W_q of layer 48 and says nothing about SQL directions; the writer's extrapolation is stated as fact. Outside the claim sample.
U1: Covers motivation, method, implementation and significance, but results lack the headline numbers (GPT-3 Table 4), the 10,000x trainable-parameter reduction, and any RoBERTa/DeBERTa/GPT-2 E2E results beyond the optimal-rank remark (L66).
U2: TL;DR (L16) is plain prose, no math, with grounded numbers; grounded limitations at L99. Repetition (L40 vs L22/L26; 3x at L16 and L50; 12,288 / r=1-2 at L16 and L44) costs concision; no distilled main-results table.
